next_architectural_lever.name: Cursor-aware structural unification
next_architectural_lever.hypothesis: unifyMode resolves entire type graphs for each pending pair, then enqueues child pairs and resolves descendants again. Traversing heads and child views directly may remove repeated materialization across many source modules.
next_architectural_lever.representation: Pending pairs carry TypeView{id,cursor}; follow variable/version heads while preserving effective child cursor. Existing head returns only an Id and is not a substitute.
next_architectural_lever.first_slice: Ordinary first-order pairs only; retain effect-row resolver and full materialization for variable binding, publication and diagnostics. Rich rank/projection/generative paths remain on original solver.
laws: Old/new views through variable chains and nested record/function children preserve effective cursors.
Binding and occurs-check reject hidden cycles and preserve shared variables.
Mismatch/OOM rollback restores type versions, effect rows, marks and retry results.
Independent uses preserve fresh covariant rows and exact callback/effect-operation input requirements.
Richer types retain existing solver acceptance and diagnostics.
Final materialized schemes/Core and depth/work-limit rejection boundaries agree.

Record exclusive check/total, unification resolve visits/nodes and allocation traffic; execute identical artifact outputs.
